groups.title: Information architecture
groups.description: Give your product a structure people can understand. Decide what belongs where, how things connect, and how people move through it.

skills.do-ia: Design a new product’s structure before you start composing screens.
skills.review-ia: Review an existing structure and find what makes it hard to navigate or understand.
skills.improve-ia: Restructure an existing product while preserving what already works.
skills.ia-vocabulary: Find the precise term for the interface pattern you’re trying to describe.
